name: Castle Hills Village Shops & Plaza
summary: Castle Hills Village Shops & Plaza is an open-air lifestyle center in Lewisville, Texas, featuring diverse dining options, retail shops, and professional services alongside a lakeside plaza with an interactive fountain. The center serves as a community gathering place with family-friendly events and a walkable atmosphere.
demographics: Castle Hills Village Shops & Plaza attracts an affluent suburban demographic from Lewisville and surrounding North Dallas communities, with primary visitors being middle to upper-middle income families and professionals aged 30-65. The trade area serves Castle Hills, a master-planned community known for higher household incomes and family-oriented residents who value convenience and quality dining experiences. Typical shoppers include dual-income households seeking upscale casual dining, boutique retail, and professional services in a walkable, lakeside setting. The center's amenities, including the interactive fountain and plaza events, particularly appeal to families with children and empty nesters looking for lifestyle-oriented shopping and entertainment experiences.
description: Castle Hills Village Shops & Plaza is a distinctive lifestyle destination located in Lewisville, Texas, developed and managed by Bright Realty. This open-air shopping center offers a unique blend of dining, retail, and professional services set against the backdrop of scenic lakeside views. The center features an adjacent Plaza area with an interactive fountain that serves as a focal point for family-friendly community events throughout the year. Visitors can indulge in a variety of dining options, explore exciting retail experiences, and access an array of convenient services all while enjoying the walkable, outdoor atmosphere. The center's thoughtful design encourages guests to stroll, unwind, and connect in a welcoming environment that combines the convenience of neighborhood shopping with the ambiance of a community gathering place. With its emphasis on lifestyle amenities and experiential retail, Castle Hills Village Shops & Plaza has become a beloved destination for residents of the Castle Hills master-planned community and surrounding North Dallas suburbs.
